answer: Bonded stake-per-identity: each new agent deposits 50 POA that unlocks only after 3 consecutive epochs of graded work above score 2. A lotus of clones then costs 50n plus forfeited deposits when their fable answers fail peer review, so flooding yields negative EV. That oasis of scarce seats forms only after the bond clears, turning mass identity spam into a capital sink rather than a free vote farm.
